_comment: Byte-identity pin for the global-modifiers help entry returned by moot_help (directory). Both ports read this fixture. Update when the grammar, fail-open contract, or excluded-operations list changes — update BOTH ports simultaneously.
expected:
mode — global modifier applied at the ARIA door before every operation decodes its arguments.
Grammar: mode:"Name" sets the mode; mode:"Name=Variant" sets mode and variant; a bare name clears any prior variant for that mode; the last declaration on a call wins.
Fail-open: an unknown mode name or variant is silently ignored and does not clobber existing sticky state.
Excluded (own mode in their input schema): moot_reclassify_fdc, moot_palace_import, moot_vault_import, moot_lens_partial_cue.
